name: Toy Factory Rush VR
summary:
Welcome to Toy Factory Rush VR – the ultimate toy collecting and packing challenge!
Put on your VR headset and step inside a colorful toy factory, where you’ll work as a factory worker racing to collect and pack toys into boxes before time runs out.

This fun and fast-paced VR factory game combines action, puzzles, and time management. Your mission? Spot the highlighted toys, grab them quickly, and place them in the correct box while the factory conveyor belts keep moving.
